tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Screen background. Paper. Everything sits on this.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section cards, grouped rows, sheets when solid. One step lighter than canvas; that step is the only elevation.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, primary button fill, selected chip fill. 15.9:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: ink-70
tokens.usage: Secondary text: notes, times, hints. 6.7:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: ink-45
tokens.usage: Idle check ring, hairline-weight icons, decorative strokes only. Never text: 2.95:1 on canvas. Labels and placeholders use ink-70.

tokens.name: ink-6
tokens.usage: Idle chip fill, segmented track, icon button fill on chrome. 6 % ink.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Card borders, row separators, outlined buttons, solid chrome stroke. No drop shadows anywhere.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The logo dot. Done disc, overdue ring, complete band, large non-text marks. Never small text (3.05:1); use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text or icon ground: overdue times, text buttons, links, mic and recording fill with white icon. 4.7:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Accent while pressed.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Overdue section tint, undo toast ground.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete only. Swipe delete button, dialog destructive action. Never for overdue.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink fills: primary button label, selected chip label.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Icon on accent disc: done tick, mic while recording.

tokens.name: chrome-fill
tokens.usage: Solid chrome fill (Android, reduce-transparency, high contrast). Same as surface by design.

tokens.name: chrome-tint
tokens.usage: Tint laid over the backdrop blur on glass chrome. 70 % light, 60 % dark. Below this, mono times under the bar stop reading.

tokens.name: chrome-stroke
tokens.usage: Hairline around glass chrome. White at 40 % light, 15 % dark.

tokens.name: chrome-highlight
tokens.usage: Specular along the top edge of glass chrome. Transparent on solid chrome.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Needs your decision: the Confirm time border and badge, health warnings. Never for overdue or delete.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind an unsure field and warning pills.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Alarm health only: allowed, ready.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Bengali", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title, reminder title on detail and alarm screens.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet and page titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Nothing is sent anywhere. No account, no sync.
styles.usage: Notes, hints, onboarding copy, dialog body. ink-70.

styles.name: alarm-title
styles.usage: Reminder title on the alarm screen only.

styles.name: button-large
styles.usage: Alarm Done and Snooze, 64 px high.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Times, dates, counts, pill values, chip labels. ink-70, accent-text when overdue.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Section headers, uppercase applied by the component. ink-70; accent-text for the overdue header. Latin only: Hindi and Bengali headers use body 13/500 sentence case, no tracking.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Alarm screen time, empty-state 00 ring. Tabular figures.

spacing.note: 4-point scale. Screen gutter is 20, the one off-scale value, so rows breathe against the device edge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tag dot to label, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gap, inside pills, between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, chip horizontal padding, floating-bar inset from screen edge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding, between card and header, sheet body gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between day sections, above the floating bar fade.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Onboarding blocks, empty state.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen left and right margin. Lists, headers, sheets.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum reminder row height.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target. Check control, icon buttons, snooze presets.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Floating chrome bars: capture bar, bottom bar.

radius.note: One system, five radii. Chrome is larger than cards on purpose: iOS 27 bars are concentric with the screen corner, not with content.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Tag chips, segmented segments, weekday tiles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Section cards, buttons, text fields, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-chrome
tokens.usage: Floating glass or solid bars.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill values, grabber, chrome pills.

blur.note: Glass chrome only. Never applied to content.

tokens.name: blur-chrome
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur sigma behind glass chrome. iOS native glass ignores this and follows the OS slider.

tokens.name: stroke-chrome
tokens.usage: Hairline width on glass chrome.
